title: Long-window B4 real-SWAP nonlinear carrier and safeguarded-Newton challenge

carrier_selection.reason: Frozen E4 already shows a READY 0.01-day, qbot=1e-6 cm/day real-Richards response with all centered head pairs available through ±1e-5 m and a >5% scale change in J_R. B5 is excluded because E4 records no symmetric derivative plateau.

tangent_estimator: Use G09D E3 unchanged: stencil-internal execution-class consistency plus first adjacent-scale <=5% slope agreement.

material_nonlinearity_gate.method: Compute E3 at href and at every fixed scan point that is participant-status 0 and E3-available. Compare each local E3 slope against href E3.
material_nonlinearity_gate.pass_rule: At least one nonzero fixed scan point must differ from the href E3 slope by >=5%.

start_selection.rule: For each sign choose the largest-magnitude fixed scan offset that is participant-status 0 and E3-available. Do not invent intermediate offsets.

groundwater_response: Fresh converged constant-flux MODFLOW6 probes; require positive affine slope and max fit error <=5e-12 m/s.
root_reference: Use real-SWAP trial residual q_swap(H)-[aH+b] and bisection inside a sign-changing interval formed by adjacent admissible fixed-scan points. If no bracket exists, classify NO_ADMISSIBLE_ROOT for that regime and do not invent a bracket.

policies.P1_E3: Raw physical Newton; E3 re-estimated at each iterate.
policies.P4_E3: Same E3 tangent with factor-1/2 backtracking until participant admissible and coupled-residual magnitude non-increasing; max 12 contractions per outer step.

decision_rules: Carrier qualification requires the frozen >=5% real-SWAP nonlinearity gate to pass.
P4 research robustness requires convergence for every regime/start pair that has an admissible reference root.
P1 outcomes are characterization; a P1 failure or merit increase followed by P4 recovery is stronger safeguard evidence but is not required for execution completion.
If P4 performs zero contractions everywhere, live safeguard activation remains open even if P4 converges.
All probes/candidates remain trial->evaluate->discard and may not mutate revision/time/ledger.
No production HCOF/RHS or production coupling change is authorized by G10.
